# StartSmart Qatar

> StartSmart Qatar is an on-demand car battery delivery and roadside-assistance service operating across Qatar. Certified technicians arrive at your location within 10 minutes (within service areas), 24/7. Pay after the service is completed. All batteries carry an 18-month manufacturer warranty.

## Services

- **Car Battery Replacement** — On-site delivery and installation of car batteries for all major vehicle brands. Stocked brands: Infinity, Bosch, Q-Energy, Exide. 18-month replacement warranty included. Average arrival: 10 minutes within service areas. Free charging-system inspection included with every replacement.
- **Emergency Jump Start** — 24/7 emergency jump-start service. Technician arrives within 10 minutes (within service areas) with professional equipment. If the battery cannot hold a charge, we replace it on the spot — no second visit.
- **Car Electrical Repair** — Mobile diagnostic and repair service for alternators, fuses, wiring, sensors, starter motors, ECU faults, and air-conditioning electrical issues. All work performed at the customer's location.

## Coverage

Service is available across all of Qatar including: Doha, Lusail, Al Rayyan, Al Wakrah, Al Khor, Madinat Khalifa, Al Duhail, Muaither, Old Airport, Industrial Area, West Bay, The Pearl, and surrounding areas. The 10-minute response promise applies within designated service areas.

## About

StartSmart Qatar is a service-area business (no walk-in workshop). All services are performed at the customer's location — home, office, or roadside. Operated by certified automotive technicians. Headquartered in Doha, Qatar.
